newsitem.title: RUSSIA: City of Moscow to issue Eurobond by March 15.
newsitem.headline: City of Moscow to issue Eurobond by March 15.

text.p: The City of Moscow will issue its first $400 million Eurobond by March 15, Russian news agencies quoted a senior Moscow government official as saying on Wednesday.
Moscow Deputy Mayor Iosif Ordzhonikidze was also quoted as saying the city government was in talks with Western banks to raise loans, the agencies said.
It has already signed agreements with Societe Generale, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Westmerchant Bank, he said.
Next week Moody's and Standard & Poor's will announce their ratings for the Moscow Eurobond, Mstislav Klimovich, municipal borrowing department head at the Moscow government told Reuters.
Nomura International and CS First First Boston will lead-manage the issue on international markets and Alfa-Bank and Stolichny Bank Sberezheny will act as join leads in Russia.
